context: Animated chord diagram showing global migration flows between 8 world regions across 5 decades, with a linked stacked area chart showing net migration over time and interactive decade slider/play controls
first_impression: Dark-themed, polished layout with a satisfying ribbon-highlight interaction and a well-integrated secondary chart, though the chord interior gets murky at peak density
what_works: The ribbon focus interaction (dimming unrelated chords to 0.08 opacity) is highly effective and satisfying to use; the linked decade highlight line syncing the area chart to the chord shows genuine information design thinking rather than two charts bolted together
what_doesnt: The Tableau 10 palette (recognized library preset) reads as chosen-by-default rather than custom-crafted for this dark background, and the dense ribbon center at 0.55 fill-opacity becomes visually muddy — individual flow directions are hard to trace without hovering
